name: accept-heartbeat-persistence
adr_title: Persist loop heartbeats across orchestrator restarts
adr_content:
# ADR-0071: Persist loop heartbeats across orchestrator restarts

**Status:** Proposed

## Context

The loop watchdog decides a background loop is hung when its in-memory heartbeat goes stale. Today heartbeats live only in process memory, so a routine orchestrator restart resets every heartbeat to "just seen." A loop that was genuinely wedged before the restart is treated as healthy for a full watchdog interval after it, delaying detection of real hangs and masking crash-restart loops.

## Decision

Persist each loop's last heartbeat timestamp to `.hydraflow/<repo>/heartbeats.json` on every cycle completion, and load it at startup. The watchdog reads the persisted value when the in-memory value is absent, so a loop that was stale before a restart is still judged stale immediately after. Writes are best-effort and never block a cycle; a corrupt or missing file degrades to the current in-memory behavior.

## Consequences

- Real hangs survive restarts and are detected within one interval instead of two.
- One extra small JSON write per loop cycle; negligible I/O against the existing per-cycle work.
- The heartbeat file becomes state that must be added to the HITL reset procedure and cleaned on repo removal.
